proposal.summary: Neo Billing 3.5 (PHP CRM/invoicing script) contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability: unfiltered input in ticket 'Subject'/'Description' fields allows attacker-supplied HTML/JS to be stored and rendered in ticket listing and thread pages.
proposal.cwe_quote: Due to improper input fields data filtering, version 3.5 (and possibly previous versions), are affected by a stored XSS vulnerability.

AC.quote: Due to improper input fields data filtering, version 3.5 (and possibly previous versions), are affected by a stored XSS vulnerability.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the issue by authenticating as a regular customer, create a ticket with the supplied XSS payload in title/content, and confirm execution context and impacted users; if confirmed, prepare a patch that properly escapes or sanitizes ticket fields and implement output encoding on ticket list/thread pages.
